Advancing Agriculture
Research-led agrochemical manufacturing for global agriculture

Bhagiradha Chemicals & Industries Limited (BCIL) is a professionally managed agrochemical manufacturer focusing on high-quality technicals and intermediates. With strong R&D capabilities and scalable manufacturing, we consistently serve our domestic and international partners with confidence.

know More

Legacy Rooted in Science

The scientific vision behind Bhagiradha

Inspired by the vision of late Sri Singavarapu Koteswara Rao, a former IICT scientist. Bhagiradha is been built on scientific rigour, integrity, and commitment to advancing Crop Protection Technology.

About Founder

A Strong Product Portfolio

Agrochemical technicals designed for global markets

Our product range is developed through strong process chemistry and produced at scale, supporting consistent quality, regulatory compliance, and dependable supply to worldwide.

Our Products
Powered by Research
Driving innovation through process chemistry and R&D

Research and Development is the backbone of Bhagiradha’s (BCIL) growth strategy. Our in-house R&D teams focus on developing non-infringing, scalable, and commercially viable processes for off-patent molecules, supported by continuous process optimisation and strong scientific innovation of IICT–CSIR.

Expanding Capability
Bheema Fine Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. powering our next phase of growth

As Bhagiradha’s (BCIL) wholly owned subsidiary, Bheema Fine Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. is designated to enhance manufacturing scale, backward integration, and operational flexibility. The facility supports future capacity expansion while reinforcing reliable and resilient supply across global markets.

Responsible Growth

Creating impact beyond our operations

At Bhagiradha, corporate responsibility extends beyond compliance. Our CSR initiatives focus on healthcare, education, and rural development, guided by a structured governance framework that creates meaningful and measurable impact for the communities surrounding our Manufacturing facility.

About Bhagiradha

Advancing Agrochemistry for Global Growth

Bhagiradha Chemicals & Industries Limited (BCIL) is a research-driven agrochemical manufacturer inspired by the vision of our founder, late Sri Singavarapu Koteswara Rao, a former IICT scientist. With strong R&D, non-infringing processes, and disciplined manufacturing, BCIL delivers reliable crop protection solutions to the global agriculture industry.

Strong Financial Performance, Sustainable Future

We are determined to meet the growing expectations in an evolving world and well-set to augment our innovation and R&D capabilities to develop processes for such technicals and intermediates that meet our clients’ needs. Our R&D Department

Building Competitive Advantage Through Chemistry

Research and Development underpins BCIL’s long-term growth. Our in-house teams develop non-infringing, scalable, and commercially viable processes for off-patent molecules. Through continuous process optimisation, cost efficiency, and IP creation, supported by strong IICT–CSIR, we deliver to meet global competitiveness.

Know More

Global Presence

A Global Footprint Built on Credibility

BCIL operates across key agricultural regions worldwide, based on it’s strong presence of consistent product quality, regulatory compliance and long-standing associations in the international markets.

Our CSR

Building Communities Through Responsible Growth

At BCIL, sustainability extends beyond products to people and communities. Our CSR initiatives focus on healthcare, education, and rural development, with priority given to regions surrounding to our manufacturing facilities. Guided by a dedicated CSR Committee, we ensure responsible governance, transparent execution, and measurable impact aligned with national CSR frameworks for long-term societal well-being.
